access_procedure: 1. Buyer pays on Xianyu; 2. Jovi verifies payment manually and creates sanitized pilot order entry; 3. Jovi generates temporary access link (e.g. Baidu Netdisk with extraction code or private direct HTTPS link); 4. Jovi pastes download link, extraction code, and SHA256 integrity hash into Xianyu private chat; 5. Jovi provides certutil verification one-liner for buyer.
expiration_revocation_policy: Download links are order-scoped or time-limited (default 7 days). Links can be revoked immediately if dispute arises.
human_verification_steps: Recompute local delivery package SHA256 before uploading/sharing
Include PowerShell command in delivery message: certutil -hashfile <filename> SHA256
